headline_seed: ICE agent shoots and wounds man in Austin, city officials say - The Washington Post
draft_text:
An ICE officer shot Wilber Rafael Garces Perez, 28, in Austin on Sunday. He was hit in the torso and is in serious but stable condition, per EMS Chief Robert Luckritz. CNN and NBC News both report he was a food delivery driver mid-shift.

And that's the mews.
